nameOrigin: remainder of a tree after being cut down

pokedexEntries.x: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.

pokedexEntries.or: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.

pokedexEntries.y: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.

pokedexEntries.as: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.

pokedexEntries.su: These Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died in the forest. Their cries sound like eerie screams.

pokedexEntries.mo: According to legend, medicine to cure any illness can be made by plucking the green leaves on its head, brewing them, and boiling down the liquid.

pokedexEntries.us: By imitating the voice of a child, it causes people to get hopelessly lost deep in the forest. It’s trying to make friends with them.

pokedexEntries.um: An unknown spirit came to lodge in a tree stump, creating this Pokémon. A cure-all can be made from an infusion of its green leaves.

pokedexEntries.sw: After a lost child perished in the forest, their spirit possessed a tree stump, causing the spirit’s rebirth as this Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.sh: With a voice like a human child’s, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

pokedexEntries.sc: Legend tells that its green leaves can cure any illness. When plucked, however, the leaves will instantly wither away.

pokedexEntries.vi: This Pokémon came to be when the spirit of a deceased child possessed a tree stump. It now wanders the forest searching for friends.

pokedexEntries.za: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.
